_meta._usage: One JSON per sūtra — reference for engine coding. null = unknown/not applicable.
_meta._ssot: panini_engine_v2 data/sutras.json + data/sk_kashika.json (sūtra id, text, sk_number, resolver fields)

resolver.soi_doi_note: Engine operationalization: Tripāḍī + saṃhitā + 8.3.2-scope; left term ends in n and is not “प्रशान्”; right begins with Cav and its next varna is in pratyāhāra am.

downstream.note: To trigger the ru-substitution stage for n-final padas before chavi contexts (e.g., भवांश्छादयति), enabling later optional nasal/anusvāra/visarga outcomes in the ru-prakaraṇa.

examples.alt_dev: 'example_dev': 'भवाम्̐श्छादयति / भवांश्छादयति', 'note': 'Engine gates the ru-ādeśa stage: भवान् + छादयति → भवार् + छादयति (later → भवांश्छादयति etc.).'}
examples.raw: {'source': 'Kashika (SanskritDocuments) 8.3.7', 'example_dev': 'भवाम्̐श्छादयति / भवांश्छादयति', 'note': 'Engine gates the ru-ādeśa stage: भवान् + छादयति → भवार् + छादयति (later → भवांश्छादयति etc.).'}

examples.alt_dev: 'example_dev': 'भवाम्̐स्तरति / भवांस्तरति', 'note': 'Also shows the same ru-prakaraṇa alternation under this rule’s scope.'}
examples.raw: {'source': 'Kashika (SanskritDocuments) 8.3.7', 'example_dev': 'भवाम्̐स्तरति / भवांस्तरति', 'note': 'Also shows the same ru-prakaraṇa alternation under this rule’s scope.'}

gloss.en: In the ru-prakaraṇa, for a n-final pada (naś), except the word praśān, before a following Cav that is am-para, ru is prescribed.
gloss.sa: रुप्रकरणे नकारान्तस्य पदस्य (प्रशान्वर्जितस्य) अम्परे छवि परतः रुः विधीयते।
